t-p6-earn-0.text: P6 Earn · readers pay the publisher through its own Stripe account, and ReputeCast takes no fee: the overview with MRR that adds up, the launch checklist, and connecting Stripe with a restricted key.

t-p6-earn-1.text: Settings · the Stripe connection with its live and test keys, webhook health and the payments event log, the 8 member emails, access rules, attribution with the conversion API, and the pages' terms.

t-p6-earn-2.text: Plans & offers · the upgrade page, tiers with their prices and paid members, offers with honest results, and the tier, offer and upgrade page editors.

t-p6-earn-3.text: Paid members · the list by paid status, the member panel with Stripe's events in its timeline, complimentary access and cancellations, and the import from Substack matched with Stripe.

t-p6-earn-4.text: Earn in the rest of the app · Paid only campaigns and the report's Revenue section, paid status in Audience, and what paid and free readers see on the public preference center, unsubscribe page and archive.

t-p6-earn-5.text: Gifts and sponsorships · gift options and every gift bought, sponsor slots and bookings by issue, and the booking panel where payments are recorded and sponsor reports are shared. Sponsorships work without Stripe.

t-p6-earn-6.text: Composer · the Sponsor block filled from the booking and always labelled, the Upgrade block for free subscribers, paid-only content in two versions, and a campaign for paid members only.

t-p6-earn-7.text: Public Earn pages in the publisher's branding · honest prices on the upgrade page, a cancel page with one offer and buttons of equal size, the gift flow, and the sponsor's read-only report.

t-p7-publish-0.text: Website · Forms & pages › Website: posts from campaigns and web-only posts, publishing to the web from the composer, the home page and navigation, members, the meter and the paywall, and every state from turning the website on to read-only.

t-p7-publish-1.text: The public site · news.acme.io in the publisher's branding: the home page, a paid post at the paywall, a member's account, and what each reader sees, from the meter to signing in without a password.

t-p7-publish-2.text: Pages and the page builder · landing pages, lead magnets, webinars and sales pages built with blocks on the publisher's theme, published with checks, with or without the website.

t-p7-publish-3.text: Public sales and landing pages · the Field Guide's sales page on news.acme.io, then the lead magnet, webinar, launch, shop, Stripe checkout and downloads as readers see them.

t-p7-publish-4.text: Digital products · a file and a price sold through the publisher's own Stripe account, orders with refunds and disputes from Stripe, and the product editor.

t-p7-publish-5.text: Shopify and WooCommerce · Acme Merch's page in the Integrations hub, connecting a store and its states, and store data in emails, automations, reports and profiles.

t-p8-channels-0.text: P8 SMS · providers and senders with their carrier registration, routing by country with quiet hours, keywords, budget and guards, and every connect, health and consent state.

t-p8-channels-1.text: SMS campaigns · the composer with its segment counter, phone preview and cost by country, Review & send with the SMS checks, and the report by country and time zone.

t-p8-channels-2.text: Automations and the public terms · SMS, push and WhatsApp steps on the flow canvas, and the text message terms page that the SMS consent text links to.

t-p8-channels-3.text: Web push is built in, with VAPID keys made here, the publication site's own service worker, a soft prompt that never spends the browser's one chance to ask, and a preview per platform that shows where each one cuts the text.

t-p8-channels-4.text: WhatsApp, optional and last, runs on Meta's Cloud API with templates synced from Meta, a campaign whose variables map to contact fields, and the 24-hour window for free-form replies.

t-p8-channels-5.text: Northwind Studio runs its own instance for seven clients: an operations overview, workspace templates and a shared library, usage to rebill, client sign-off by the client's own approver, and staff assignments.
